name: Road To Emmaus
overview: The Road to Emmaus narrative reveals a powerful post-resurrection encounter where Jesus appears in an unexpected form to two disciples traveling away from Jerusalem, emphasizing the reality of His resurrection and ongoing presence (Mark 16:12; Luke 24:13). This event unfolds shortly after the discovery of the empty tomb early on the first day of the week (Luke 24:1), underscoring the fulfillment of Scripture and the divine nature of Christ, who is the eternal Word with God and is God Himself (John 1:1). Together, these verses highlight the transformational recognition of Jesus as the risen Lord and the foundation of Christian faith.
